definitions.explanation: A substance formed when two or more chemical elements are bonded together in a fixed ratio. Distinguished from mixtures, where components are not chemically bonded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{化合物|かごうぶつ}です。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{化合物|かごうぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{元素|げんそ}→元素：09662_genso⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This compound is made up of two elements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{化合物|かごうぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: The researchers continued experimenting for years to synthesize a new compound.

notes:
Composed of {化合|かごう} (chemical combination) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (substance). A fundamental term in chemistry education, encountered from middle school science onward in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧{化合物|かごうぶつ}: organic compound
- {無機|むき}{化合物|かごうぶつ}: inorganic compound
- {化合物|かごうぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: synthesize a compound
- ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧{化合物|かごうぶつ}: chemical compound

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{混合物|こんごうぶつ}→混合物：21415_kongoubutsu⟧: mixture — components are not chemically bonded and can be separated physically
- ⟦{元素|げんそ}→元素：09662_genso⟧: element — a pure substance consisting of one type of atom
- ⟦{分子|ぶんし}→分子：11769_bunshi⟧: molecule — the smallest unit of a compound that retains its chemical properties
